g.text: E045 · C1 / C8 command-buffer configuration screen
8 measured requests + 8 warm requests per fresh process · screen only, NOT a formal Pareto frontier
MLX_MAX_MB_PER_BUFFER = 16 / 50 / 200 / 800; 50 MB repeated before and after each C. Other settings fixed.
¹ Minimum ratio against both 50-MB bookends. Selection requires both ratios ≥1.03 and both bookend drifts ≤2%, plus exact returned IDs.
Axes use separate focused scales; label leaders are not performance curves. 512/p50 is latency-derived, not P90 interactivity or measured ITL.
Audit: FAIL_TOKEN_EQUIVALENCE. C8 baseline also differs between runs; cause is unclassified. No full-state or engine-frontier claim.
